Definition: The variety of code-switching between Tagalog and English in which these messages are written.
The share of a message's language-dependent tokens that fall outside its matrix language, reported as a percentage.
The process by which incoming messages are sorted by urgency during and after a typhoon event.
The formal name of the paradigm in which one model is fitted to several tasks at once.
The prediction granularity in which one label is assigned to each token of a message.
The prediction granularity in which one label is assigned to a whole message.
The task in which location and infrastructure mentions are located and typed in a message.
The task in which one humanitarian need is assigned to each message.
The task in which one urgency level is assigned to each message.

The class of methods by which the influence of each task on training is set, comprising loss balancing, in which the task losses are weighted, and gradient balancing, in which the per-task gradients are altered before the update.
Posts about a typhoon event that are written in Taglish.
